passport.title: How to apply for an Ethiopian passport
passport.subtitle: A practical starting point for Ethiopian citizens. Passport requirements, fees, appointment availability, and processing times can change, so confirm the current instructions with the Ethiopian Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS) before applying.

steps.title: Choose the right service
steps.description: On the official ICS service, select the option that matches your situation: first passport, renewal, replacement, or an application for a minor.

steps.title: Check the current document checklist
steps.description: Review the requirements shown for your service before you begin. The documents can differ by application type and personal circumstances. Use official civil and identity records, and make sure your details match.

steps.title: Complete the application
steps.description: Follow the official passport application link from ICS, create or sign in to your account, and enter your personal information exactly as it appears on your supporting documents.

steps.title: Submit documents and pay the official fee
steps.description: Upload or provide the requested documents and pay only through a payment method authorized by the official service. Keep your confirmation and receipt.

steps.title: Attend any required appointment
steps.description: Follow the instructions for booking and attending an appointment. Bring the required originals; the service will tell you whether a photo, fingerprints, or other biometric capture is needed.

steps.title: Track your application and collect your passport
steps.description: Use the official tracking instructions and follow the collection or delivery instructions given for your application.

passport.important: This guide is informational, not an official application or legal advice. Exact requirements, fees, appointment steps, and processing times may change. Use the ICS website to reach its current passport service, and avoid unofficial payment or application links.
passport.source: Official source: Ethiopian Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS)

embassyScholarships.title: Embassy scholarships for Ethiopian students
embassyScholarships.intro: Some governments announce scholarships through their embassies in Ethiopia. These examples are useful places to check, but the programs, eligible study levels, application route, and deadlines can change each year.
embassyScholarships.availabilityNote: A program listed here is not necessarily accepting applications right now. Check the embassy announcement and scholarship portal for the latest call, eligibility rules, deadline, and submission method. Apply only through official channels.

programs.description: MEXT scholarships may be announced through the embassy recommendation route. Categories and eligibility differ by annual call; follow the embassy notice for the application procedure.

The Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) runs scholarship programs for international students. Check the portal for the current offer, country eligibility, courses, and application instructions.

programs.embassy: Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Ethiopia
programs.description: GKS has different application tracks, including an embassy track for some programs. Check the annual notice for Ethiopian eligibility, available degree levels, quotas, and how to submit.

embassyScholarships.documentsIntro: Prepare these common documents as a starting point. Each scholarship has its own checklist, formats, translations, and submission rules; the official call always takes priority.

documents.title: Passport and identity records
documents.description: A valid passport if available, plus the national ID or other identity documents specifically requested by the scholarship.

documents.title: Academic certificates and transcripts
documents.description: Certificates and complete transcripts for the levels already completed. Arrange certified translations or authentication only when the call requires them.

documents.title: Application form and photograph
documents.description: The correct form, completed and signed as instructed, and a recent passport-style photo if requested.

documents.title: CV or résumé
documents.description: An up-to-date education and experience history in the format requested by the program.

documents.title: Motivation letter or study plan
documents.description: A focused statement explaining your study goals and fit. Research-degree applicants may also need a proposal.

documents.title: Recommendation letters
documents.description: Letters from the required academic or professional referees, submitted in the way specified in the call.

documents.title: Language test results
documents.description: IELTS, TOEFL, or other proof only when required or accepted as an alternative by that program.

documents.title: Additional program-specific evidence
documents.description: For example, medical forms, portfolio, proof of work experience, admission letter, or financial documents when the official call asks for them.

embassyScholarships.appointmentTitle: If you are asked to attend in person
embassyScholarships.appointmentNote: Take the appointment confirmation and the originals plus copies of the documents requested in the official notice. Do not hand over original documents unless the embassy or program explicitly instructs you to do so. Requirements vary by program and application stage.
